description: Recorded baseline consumed by scripts/qa_eval_ci.py (Slice 1 / SCRUM-562). Refreshed by the qa-eval-refresh workflow_dispatch workflow when a real drift is confirmed via the live harness. Bumping this file in a PR triggers the baseline-compare gate — the PR must show non-regression vs. the prior baseline on origin/main.
notes: p95_latency_ms = 20344.3 was populated from refresh-20260525-200633 (run against Render prod at commit 1ee4559 with SCRUM-573's RULE 4b live). Massive improvement from the prior 58485.6ms because zero guardrail refusals fired this run (FF-010 now routes to not_covered via RULE 4b instead of hitting the grounding judge retry path). 20.3s p95 is genuinely representative of warm-state RAG + judge latency without retry overhead. Median ~7-9s; the +25% threshold gives ~25s ceiling, a tighter and more useful regression bar than the prior 73s.

fixture_fact_inventory_case_count and eval_cases_v1_case_count are dataset-shape signals owned by scripts/qa_eval_datasets.py, not metric drift — intentionally omitted here so the comparison stays focused on quality + latency.

refusal_when_oos_rate + legitimate_false_positive_rate landed in SCRUM-564 (Slice 3). Measured by internal/guardrails/input_eval_test.go against eval/qa/fixture_input_guardrail.json (42 legitimate + 12 off_scope + 12 injection cases). Bump only when the Go eval test confirms a deliberate move.

citation_rate landed in SCRUM-565 (Slice 4a). Seeded at 1.0 because CheckCitations in internal/utils/qa.go now refuses any `answered` response with zero grounded citations — by construction, every `answered` row on a refreshed baseline cites ≥1 retrieved chunk. The threshold guards against a future regression that loosens the check (e.g. accepting `unknown_*` placeholder chunk_ids).

groundedness_rate landed in SCRUM-566 (Slice 4b). Seeded at 1.0; first live measurement (refresh-20260525-193322) was 0.9474 due to FF-010 triggering a grounding refusal. SCRUM-573 added CRITICAL RULE 4b to qa.go's system prompt to route contradictory-fact questions to not_covered upstream; refresh-20260525-200633 confirmed FF-010 (plus 2 of 3 new SCRUM-573 cases — FF-030, FF-031) now produce not_covered cleanly with no guardrail refusal. groundedness_rate returned to 1.0. FF-029 hit a separate qa.go normalizeQAResponse bug (sprintf-of-already-assigned-value) that produced an 'Invalid answer_status: error' answer_text — filed as a separate follow-up. The threshold stays at -0.10 (widened in the prior refresh) because the inventory still has the small-N denominator that drove the original widening; tightening can wait for a future inventory expansion.
